briefdescription.para: Calculate SMBus Packet Error Checking (PEC) CRC-8 byte. Polynomial: x^8 + x^2 + x + 1 (0x07), Initial value: 0x00.

parameterdescription.para: Running CRC value (0x00 for fresh calculation).

briefdescription.para: Encode an SMBus packet into a byte stream for transmission.

parameterdescription.para: Pointer to receive encoded byte count.

simplesect.para: SYN_OK on success, or error status.

memberdef.argsstring: (SYN_SMBUS_Packet *pkt, const uint8_t *rx_buf, size_t rx_len, SYN_SMBUS_Protocol proto, bool has_pec)
memberdef.name: syn_smbus_decode_packet

briefdescription.para: Decode an SMBus byte stream into an SMBus packet structure.

parameterdescription.para: True if PEC byte is appended at end of rx_buf.

simplesect.para: SYN_OK on success, SYN_ERR_INVALID_CHECKSUM if PEC mismatch, or SYN_ERR_INVALID_PARAM.
